text.p: Pinnacle Resources Ltd expects to report earnings per share for 1996 of about C$0.48 against C$0.46 for the previous year, Stuart Clark, the company's chief executive officer, told a conference on Friday.
Clark also said Pinnacle expected earnings per share of C$0.64 for 1997.

The company, which will report earnings next week, is working on a projected sales price of C$21.27 per barrel of oil and C$1.57 per million cubic feet of gas for 1996 and C$20.81 per barrel of oil and C$1.73 per mcf for gas for 1997.
It expects sales to rise to C$164 million in 1997 from a projected C$126.8 million in 1996 and an actual C$99.9 million in 1995. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
